name: @mpd-dsh/worktree
description: Per-member git worktrees for team/cellwork write agents: the five mpd_worktree_* tools, the .mpd/worktrees/index.json state file and the mpdWorktree service (createForMember/cwdForMember) that degrades instead of failing

scripts.build: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && .toolchain/node_modules/.bin/bun build packages/mpd-worktree-plugin/src/index.ts --target node --format esm --outfile packages/mpd-worktree-plugin/dist/index.js
